Join a collaborative professional learning community designed for secondary school counselors serving English Learners in Orange County. Participants will explore the English Learner Roadmap and its implications for school counseling, engage with practical strategies and resources from the EL Counselor Toolkit, and collaborate with colleagues to strengthen academic and social-emotional support for English Learners.

Connect directly with OCDE for individualized school counseling support in an open, one-on-one setting. School counselors and counselor leaders may schedule time to ask questions, discuss programs or resources, and share their needs, ideas, or challenges—without a set agenda.
Intended Audience: TK–12 school counselors and counselor leaders
